name: George
output_format_note: The requested mp3_44100_192 format is Creator tier and above. This account is on the Free tier, so the API returned HTTP 403 subscription_required for 192 kbps. All audio was generated at mp3_44100_128, the highest format available on the plan.
selection_rationale: George is a premade warm storyteller with a clear, human delivery. His tone fits a hopeful community ad better than a news-style broadcaster or a very deep character voice: trustworthy and calm without sounding hypey.

tests.name: george
tests.notes: Warm, clear storyteller. Selected for the final read.

tests.name: daniel
tests.notes: Steady broadcaster. Clear, but more news-read than neighborhood story.

tests.name: brian
tests.notes: Deep and comforting. Good warmth, but heavier than the hopeful, forward-moving read the ad needs.

test_text: Every neighborhood has one. A pothole everyone avoids. This morning, Sam decides to change that.
